stream.note: url: the BBC's own worldwide HLS stream (320 kb/s AAC, 6.4 s segments, no encryption). service: the id of the BBC's now-playing feed, rms.api.bbc.co.uk/v2/services/<service>/segments/latest. The installer writes both into <azimuth>/Radio1Dance/stream.ini, which the DLL reads.

live.note: two 16-minute tracks that the DLL serves as the live stream; two so the radio always has a next track to pick
